tracesTo: UserFlow: Manager / Fan Onboarding, Claiming & Role Assignment

stories.title: Admin Views Pending Membership Requests
stories.goal: view all pending membership requests in a centralized queue
stories.benefit: I can efficiently review and manage users waiting to join the league
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can access a dedicated membership approval queue from their admin dashboard
Queue displays pending user requests with username, requested role, team preference (if applicable), and request timestamp
Queue shows claim validation status for manager requests
Admin can filter pending requests by role type (manager/fan) and sort by date

stories.title: Admin Approves Member Request
stories.benefit: I can grant access to legitimate users who want to join our league
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can click an 'Approve' action on any pending request
System creates the membership record with the approved role and team assignment
Approved user receives notification and gains access to league clubhouse
Request is removed from pending queue and logged in approval history
System validates team assignment is still available for manager claims before approval

stories.title: Admin Denies Member Request
stories.goal: deny a pending membership request with optional reason
stories.benefit: I can reject inappropriate or suspicious requests and maintain league quality
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can click a 'Deny' action on any pending request
Admin can optionally provide a reason for denial
Denied user receives notification with reason if provided
Request is removed from pending queue and logged in denial history
User can submit a new request after denial

stories.title: Auto-Join for Open Leagues
stories.goal: automatically join a league without admin approval when auto-join is enabled
stories.benefit: I can immediately access the league clubhouse without waiting for approval
acceptanceCriteria: When league visibility rules allow auto-join, user is immediately granted membership upon registration/claiming
User bypasses approval queue entirely and gains instant access
Role and team assignments are applied immediately based on claim selection
System logs auto-join event in membership history
Admin can view auto-joined members in membership roster

stories.title: Manual Approval for Restricted Leagues
stories.goal: submit a membership request and wait for admin approval in restricted leagues
stories.benefit: I can express interest in joining the league and understand my request is being reviewed
acceptanceCriteria: When league visibility rules require approval, user enters approval queue after registration/claiming
User sees a confirmation message explaining their request is pending admin review
User receives notification when request is approved or denied
User cannot access league clubhouse content until approved
User can cancel their pending request if desired

stories.title: Admin Releases Team Claim
stories.goal: release a manager's team claim and make it available for reassignment
stories.benefit: I can handle situations where a manager is inactive or needs to be removed from a team
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can select a manager and release their team claim
System prompts for confirmation before releasing claim
Released team becomes available for other users to claim
Original manager is demoted to fan role or removed from league based on admin choice
System notifies the affected user of the claim release
Action is logged in league admin history

stories.title: Admin Reassigns Team Claim
stories.goal: transfer a team claim from one user to another
stories.benefit: I can correct mistakes or handle ownership changes for teams
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can select a team and reassign it to a different user
System validates the target user is a league member
Original manager is demoted to fan role or maintains membership based on admin choice
New manager gains full access to their team's history and identity
Both users are notified of the reassignment
Reassignment is logged with reason if provided

stories.title: Admin Promotes Fan to Manager
stories.goal: promote a fan to manager role by assigning them an available team
stories.benefit: I can give existing fans ownership of teams when needed
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can select a fan member and choose 'Promote to Manager' action
System displays available unclaimed teams for assignment
Admin selects a team to assign to the fan
User's role changes from fan to manager with team assignment
User is notified of the promotion
Promotion is logged in admin history

stories.title: Admin Demotes Manager to Fan
stories.goal: demote a manager to fan role and release their team claim
stories.benefit: I can adjust user roles when team ownership changes or managers become inactive
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can select a manager and choose 'Demote to Fan' action
System prompts for confirmation and optional reason
Manager's team claim is released and becomes available
User's role changes to fan but maintains league membership
User can optionally select a favorite team as a fan
User is notified of the demotion with reason if provided
Demotion is logged in admin history

stories.title: User Views Their Membership Status
stories.goal: see my current membership status, role, and team assignment
stories.benefit: I understand my access level and team affiliation in the league
acceptanceCriteria: User can view their membership details in account/profile settings
Display shows current role (manager/fan), team assignment, and membership date
If pending approval, display shows 'Pending Approval' status with request date
User can see which leagues they are a member of and their role in each
User can access this information from league switcher or profile menu
